title: Мальчик учится кататься на скейте
extra: plus a tiny bright helmet and soft knee pads
location: Bright colorful kids skate park, soft sunlight, smooth pastel ramps, big cute friendly 3D shapes.
intro: He learns to skateboard with hard cuts, one step per shot:

shots.action: stands next to a little red skateboard, points to it
carefully puts one foot on the board, wobbles a little
pushes with his other foot, rolls slowly
balances with arms out, rolls smoothly
smiles big, gives a thumbs up
